config.safeinteract.title: SafeInteract Settings
config.safeinteract.option.enabled.toolt: Master switch for all safeguards and indicators.
config.safeinteract.option.actionBarEnab: Show status and safety messages above the hotbar.
config.safeinteract.option.buildGuardEna: Prevent held use from activating interactive blocks while building.
config.safeinteract.option.entityGuardEn: Prevent held use from rotating item frames, swapping armor stand gear, opening trades or boarding vehicles while building.
config.safeinteract.option.holdThreshold: Use is considered held after this many ticks.
config.safeinteract.option.guardedBlocks: Block IDs to treat as interactive. Ignored blocks take precedence.
config.safeinteract.option.ignoredBlocks: Block IDs to treat as non-interactive, even if always guarded.
config.safeinteract.option.durabilityGua: Stop Smart Hold and (optionally) block manual tool use before a damageable item breaks.
config.safeinteract.option.durabilityThr: Protect items at or below this remaining durability.
config.safeinteract.option.durabilityGua: Block low-durability tool actions on blocks.
Protect tools when mining and attacking
Cancel block breaking and attacks with a low-durability tool or weapon.
config.safeinteract.option.entityPierceE: Hold the Entity Pierce key to target past selected entities.
config.safeinteract.option.pierceVillage: Ignore villagers and wandering traders while piercing.
config.safeinteract.option.pierceBoats.t: Ignore boats and rafts while piercing.
config.safeinteract.option.holdFullInven: Stop Smart Hold RMB when no inventory slot is empty.
Stop Smart Hold LMB when no inventory slot is empty.
config.safeinteract.option.holdDamageGua: Stop Smart Hold when you take damage.
config.safeinteract.option.holdSlotGuard: Stop on item or slot change
Stop when the selected slot or main-hand item changes.
config.safeinteract.option.holdMovementG: Stop when you move too far from the starting position.
config.safeinteract.option.holdMovementT: Maximum distance in blocks from the starting position.
config.safeinteract.option.holdTargetLos: Stop if the initially targeted block remains air.
How long the initial target may remain air before stopping.
config.safeinteract.option.hudShowGuardP: Flash an amber shield when an interaction is blocked.
config.safeinteract.option.hudShowPierce: Show a cyan shield while Entity Pierce is active.
config.safeinteract.option.hudShowHold.t: Show a pulsing indicator while holding and a red flash on abort.
config.safeinteract.option.hudOffsetX.to: Horizontal offset from the crosshair in scaled pixels.
config.safeinteract.option.hudOffsetY.to: Vertical offset from the crosshair in scaled pixels.
config.safeinteract.option.soundsEnabled: Play local sounds for toggles and safety events.
